'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese Civil War]]
**[[Siege of El Fasher]]
***[[Zamzam and Abu Shouk refugee camp massacres]]
****At least 100 people, including 20 children, are killed in [[Rapid Support Forces]] attacks on [[Al-Fashir]] and two nearby [[internal displacement|displacement camps]] in [[North Darfur]], [[Sudan]], according to the [[United Nations]]. *[[Gaza war]]
**[[Rafah offensive]]
***The [[Israel Defense Forces]] announces the completion of the [[Morag Corridor]], completely cutting off the city of [[Rafah]] from the rest of the [[Gaza Strip]] and effectively turning it into an Israeli security zone. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/4/12/live-dozens-of-israeli-attacks-kill-only-women-children-in-gaza-un (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**A [[Ukrainian Air Force]] [[General Dynamics F-16 Fighting Falcon|F-16 Fighting Falcon]] is shot down by a [[S-400 missile system|S-400 missile]] during combat operations against [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]], with the pilot [[killed in action]]. [https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-society/3981341-ukraines-f16-pilot-killed-while-performing-combat-mission.html (Ukrinform)] [https://www.defensemirror.com/news/39280 (Defense Mirror)]
*[[Sistan and Baluchestan insurgency]]
**Eight [[Pakistan]]i citizens are killed in a [[mass shooting]] by [[Baloch Nationalist Army]] gunmen in [[Mehrestan]], [[Sistan and Baluchestan province]], [[Iran]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/4/14/islamabad-seeks-answers-after-eight-pakistanis-shot-dead-in-iran (Al Jazeera)]
*Three [[prison officer]]s sustain life-threatening injuries in a [[mass stabbing]] and burn attack when [[Manchester Arena bombing#Investigations and inquiries|Hashem Abedi]], the brother of [[Islamic terrorism|Islamic terrorist]] [[Manchester Arena bombing#Investigations and inquiries|Salman Abedi]], the perpetrator of the [[Manchester Arena bombing]] in 2017, attacks prison officers at [[HM Prison Frankland]] in [[County Durham]], [[England]], with hot cooking oil and [[Shiv (weapon)|shiv]]s. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cz95kggw7nxo (BBC News)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Tariffs in the second Trump administration]]
** [[China–United States trade war]]
***[[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]]'s administration exempts [[smartphone]]s and [[computer]]s from all "reciprocal" tariffs, including the base 10% on all countries and the 125% levies imposed on [[China|Chinese]] imports. [[White House Deputy Chief of Staff]] [[Stephen Miller (political advisor)|Stephen Miller]] states that a separate 20% tariff on Chinese imports remains in effect for the products.  [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c20xn626y81o (BBC News)]
*[[Steel Industry (Special Measures) Act 2025]]
**The [[Government of the United Kingdom|British government]] passes emergency legislation to [[Nationalization|control]] some management decisions at [[British Steel (2016–present)|British Steel]] in order to prevent the closure of the [[Jingye Group]]-owned [[Scunthorpe Steelworks]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/live/cyvqm83z1nrt (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Copake plane crash]]
**A [[Mitsubishi MU-2|Mitsubishi MU-2B]] aircraft en route from [[Westchester County Airport]] to [[Columbia County Airport]] crashes into a field in [[Copake, New York|Copake]], [[New York (state)|New York]], United States, killing all six occupants onboard.  [https://wnyt.com/top-stories/fatal-plane-crash-in-copake-area-columbia-county/ (NBC News)]
